The user wants the letter of the trajectory that makes the room a tiny bit brighter. Looking at the image, the dimmer switch has a paddle in the middle. There are four arrows: green (up, long), purple (up, short), light pink (down, short), blue (right, sideways).

To make the room brighter, the dimmer should be turned up. The green arrow goes up a long distance (a lot brighter). The purple arrow goes up a short distance (a tiny bit brighter). The question asks for "a tiny bit brighter," so the small upward movement is purple. Blue is sideways, irrelevant. Light pink is down, dimmer.

Thus the answer is A (Purple).
